Welsh Water has no shareholders 💧
Since 2001 Dŵr Cymru Welsh Water has been owned by Glas Cymru, which calls itself the first not-for-profit utility in Wales and England. Financial surpluses are kept for the benefit of customers, and by 2021 it had returned £440m as customer dividends. It supplies 3 million people across most of Wales, Herefordshire and parts of Deeside.
